Visa & Travel Information

Visa-Free Entry

As of 2026, citizens from 50 countries can enter China visa-free for 15-30 days, including USA, UK, Canada, Australia, Germany, France, Italy, Spain, and more.

Best Time to Visit

Spring (April-May): Mild weather, cherry blossoms
Autumn (September-October): Clear skies, colorful foliage
Avoid: National holidays (Oct 1-7, May 1-5)

Essential Apps

WeChat: Payments, messaging, mini-programs
Alipay: Mobile payments everywhere
DiDi: Ride-hailing (like Uber)
Baidu Maps: Navigation (Google Maps blocked)

Emergency Contacts

Police: 110
Ambulance: 120
Fire: 119
Tourist Hotline: 12301
Embassy: Contact your country's embassy in Beijing
